title: Convert Temple kit to the style-picker model (schema 2 manifest, dials, accents, Looks)
detail:
Plan step 9 for Temple kit: (1) manifest to schema 2 declaring today's four dials supported with THEME_LOOK defaults (owners see no change); (2) register, accent swatches, type voice, motion, hero/header/footer variants, image treatment, Looks, theme dials as the style system allows; (3) functions table mapping existing blocks to the twelve functions; conformance suite green before any dial flips to supported. NEEDS FROM DANIEL: Updated Temple style system: the thirteen accents as swatches, arch-shape theme dial, Looks, kits.

The arch motif stays fixed. The picker shows existing Temple profile swatches that clear filled-label contrast, with four profile Looks.
